units.source_text: 于是，神简直像玩捉迷藏似的，若无其事地变成了野花。

en.t: And so, as if playing hide-and-seek, the god casually turned into a wildflower.

units.source_text: 森林中的美丽妖精贝尔蒂斯，为了躲开不是她丈夫的年轻人充满爱情的目光，变成了雏菊。

en.t: Bertis, the beautiful fairy of the forest, turned into a daisy to escape the love-filled gaze of a young man who was not her husband.
